en: A black-and-white, multi-view postcard featuring four different scenes from a rural village. The top left shows a church steeple behind trees, the top right displays a residential building with a distinctive patterned fence, the bottom left features a traditional half-timbered house, and the bottom right shows another half-timbered building labeled 'Gasthaus' (inn or guesthouse) surrounded by foliage. The caption in the center reads 'NECKANITZ Kreis Meißen'.
